calibration_status.statement: This policy states composition rules, not calibrated scientific settings. It declares no temporal, feature, or agreement threshold of its own, so there is nothing here to calibrate; every numeric threshold that bounds the evidence lives in the versioned pairwise matching specification the source analyses already recorded.

algorithm.summary: Compose the exact candidate edges of a complete set of pairwise matching analyses into components over native detections, for one recording and N distinct extractors.

source_analyses.coverage_reason: Every unordered extractor pair must have been assessed exactly once. Without complete coverage, an absent supporting edge cannot be distinguished from a pair that was never compared, and any agreement pattern derived from the result would be unreadable.
source_analyses.specification_reason: Two pairwise analyses run under different matching specifications have different candidate universes. Composing them would produce a component whose edges answer different questions.
source_analyses.immutability: A source analysis is read, never rewritten. Its candidate rows, groups, consensus events, and consilience assessments are untouched by composition.

edge_universe.threshold_authority: the versioned matching specification recorded by each source analysis
edge_universe.reason: The candidate universe is already bounded by each source analysis's own min_temporal_iou floor. Declaring a second threshold here would create two authorities that can disagree, and would silently re-filter evidence the pairwise layer already decided.

composition.clique_reason: Requiring every unordered pair inside a component to carry a supporting edge would discard the genuinely partial patterns three extractors produce. Completeness is derivable from the stored edges and is reported rather than enforced.
composition.singleton_reason: A detection no other extractor corroborated is single-extractor evidence, which is the arbitrary-N analogue of an unmatched pairwise group. Dropping it would make the derived population disagree with the native one.
composition.ambiguity_reason: A pairwise group's topology is derivable from each supporting edge and is reported. An ambiguous pairwise topology never removes an edge or a member from the derived component.
composition.feature_support_reason: Potential feature support, realized availability, and observed outcome are separate queryable dimensions. None of them decides whether a detection or an edge belongs to a component.

separately_queryable_dimensions: temporal correspondence and its metrics, from the cited candidate rows
pairwise topology, derivable from each cited edge
potential feature support, from the exact registered feature relationships
realized feature availability, from the member detections' measurements
observed feature outcome, from the pairwise comparison under its declared tolerances
prohibitions: no membership or supporting-edge row may be withheld because a feature-support category is weak, unavailable, or below a categorical minimum
no stored support count, support fraction, completeness measure, extractor-set label, or agreement pattern label
no rewriting of a source pairwise analysis
non_filtering_contract.filtering_belongs_to: later query, report, and exploratory-analysis surfaces, which may sort and filter on any dimension above

analysis_identity.canonical_source_order: ascending sorted extractor-name pair, then source analysis run_key
reuse_requires: same agreement policy profile version and checksum
same set of source pairwise analyses
analysis_identity.status_reason: An applied run that carries lineage but no composed groups is deliberately left 'started'. Marking it 'completed' would claim a derivation that has not been performed.
